bibl.title: La filologia ad Ossirinco: scribi, diorthotai, eruditi. Indagini su materiali papiracei di età romana (secoli I a.C. - III d.C.).
bibl.seg: Chiara Martis, La filologia ad Ossirinco: scribi, diorthotai, eruditi. Indagini su materiali papiracei di età romana (secoli I a.C. - III d.C.).
bibl.note: Discusses the technical aspects of the ἔκδοσις ("publication") of a literary work by examining the procedures established by publishing houses, scholars, and sophisticated readers, as such modes of intervention can be observed from Oxyrhynchus papyri of the Ist cent. B.C. to IIIrd cent. A.D.
